GH-GOV-01.name: Record keeping
GH-GOV-01.description: Customer identity files, transaction records and reports are kept 5 years (after the relationship ends, from the transaction, or from the report date). Payment-platform audit logs are kept 6 years.
GH-GOV-01.action: Deny deletion before the period ends
GH-GOV-01.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-01 | type=control
WHEN  record.delete_requested
IF    ( record.type IN (customer_file) AND record.age < tenant.cfg.gh_retention_years after relationship_end )
   OR ( record.type IN (transaction, report) AND record.age < tenant.cfg.gh_retention_years after (txn OR report_date) )
      # default 5y; audit logs 6y under GH-SEC-11
THEN  deny_delete  reason=retention
GH-GOV-01.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-08. Default: On. Basis: GS3 (s.32, per summary); GS24

GH-GOV-02.name: No tipping off
GH-GOV-02.description: Nothing about an STR, a suspicion flag, an FIC order or a freeze appears in customer-facing screens, API responses, webhooks or exports. Failure to report carries 500-4,000 penalty units and up to 5 years in prison.
GH-GOV-02.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-02 | type=control
WHEN  api.response OR webhook.send OR export.generate
IF    payload CONTAINS (str.exists OR str.status OR fic_order OR flag.visibility = compliance_only)
AND   recipient.role NOT IN (compliance_officer, mlro)
THEN  strip_fields  AND  log=audit
GH-GOV-02.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-09. Default: On. Basis: GS3 (s.38(4))

GH-GOV-03.name: Approved reporting to the FIC
GH-GOV-03.description: STRs, CTRs and electronic transfer reports are prepared by the system but a compliance officer approves before submission. The goAML channel is claimed by a vendor but not confirmed, so the channel is a tenant setting.
GH-GOV-03.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-03 | type=workflow
WHEN  report.draft_ready (STR, CTR, ECTR)
IF    report.approved_by IN roles(compliance_officer)
THEN  allow_submit  via=tenant.cfg.fic_channel     # goAML not confirmed for Ghana
ELSE  hold_for_approval
GH-GOV-03.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-06. Default: On. Basis: GS11 (goAML claim, unverified)

GH-GOV-04.name: Customer review cycle
GH-GOV-04.description: Existing customers are reviewed at least every two years, with enhanced ongoing monitoring for PEPs.
GH-GOV-04.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-04 | type=job | schedule=daily
IF    customer.last_review_age >= tenant.cfg.gh_review_cycle      # default 2y
THEN  task=periodic_review
GH-GOV-04.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS2 (s.2.4.5)

GH-GOV-05.name: Annual testing and twice-yearly training
GH-GOV-05.description: The AML system is tested at least yearly and staff are trained at least twice a year.
GH-GOV-05.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-05 | type=job | schedule=daily
IF    aml_system.last_tested > 12mo OR staff.training_events_last_12mo < 2
THEN  readiness=fail  reason=bog_guideline_testing_training
GH-GOV-05.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS2 (ss.2.10, 2.3.3)

GH-GOV-06.name: Continuous screening and UN list drills
GH-GOV-06.description: Sanctions, PEP and adverse-media checks at onboarding and continuously, with periodic drills and quarterly reporting where E.I. 2 requires them.
GH-GOV-06.action: Run GH-REG-07 and GH-REG-08 for all parties
GH-GOV-06.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-06 | type=control
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR list.updated OR daily_job
THEN  run GH-REG-08 AND GH-REG-07 AND adverse_media_screen FOR customer, beneficial_owner, counterparty
WHEN  quarter.end
THEN  task=sanctions_report_and_drill   # E.I. 2 per summary; verify recipient and format
GH-GOV-06.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-05. Default: On. Basis: GS7

GH-GOV-07.name: Forex bureau compliance calendar
GH-GOV-07.description: Forex bureaux file an annual audit by 30 April and a training submission by 31 December, and fix findings within 45 days.
GH-GOV-07.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-07 | type=calendar
SCOPE tenant.type = forex_bureau
WHEN  date = 30-Apr  THEN task=submit.annual_audit
WHEN  date = 31-Dec  THEN task=submit.training_report
WHEN  audit.finding_opened  THEN task=remediate  due=45d
GH-GOV-07.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS9

GH-GOV-08.name: Data protection registration and impact assessments
GH-GOV-08.description: Register with the Data Protection Commission before processing and renew every 2 years; run an impact assessment for high-risk processing.
GH-GOV-08.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-08 | type=job | schedule=daily
IF    tenant.dpc_registration.expiry < now + 90d OR tenant.dpc_registration IS NULL
THEN  readiness=fail  reason=dpc_registration
IF    processing.high_risk = true AND dpia.completed = false
THEN  readiness=fail  reason=dpia_missing
GH-GOV-08.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS26

GH-GOV-09.name: Critical-infrastructure governance
GH-GOV-09.description: A designated critical information infrastructure owner appoints a cybersecurity officer, keeps a 24/7 contact for the CSA and undergoes regular compliance audits.
GH-GOV-09.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-09 | type=policy
SCOPE tenant.cii_designated = true
IF    tenant.cyber_officer IS NULL OR tenant.csa_24x7_contact IS NULL OR cii_audit.last_done > tenant.cfg.cii_audit_cycle
THEN  readiness=fail  reason=cii_governance
GH-GOV-09.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS19 (secondary)

GH-GOV-10.name: Digital credit provider licence check
GH-GOV-10.description: A digital lender cannot be activated without its Bank of Ghana licence under the September 2025 digital credit directive.
GH-GOV-10.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-10 | type=policy
WHEN  tenant.activate
IF    tenant.type = digital_lender AND tenant.bog_dcsp_licence IS NULL
THEN  deny_activate  reason=missing_bog_digital_credit_licence
GH-GOV-10.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of GOV-10. Default: On. Basis: GS32

GH-GOV-11.name: Virtual-asset provider licence status
GH-GOV-11.description: A virtual-asset tenant records its Bank of Ghana or SEC registration, licence or waiver. Licensing is not yet live, so the check ships off and VASPs are treated as accountable institutions meanwhile.
GH-GOV-11.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-11 | type=policy
WHEN  tenant.activate
SCOPE tenant.type = vasp AND tenant.cfg.gh_vasp_check_enabled = true
IF    tenant.vasp_route NOT IN (registration, licence, waiver)
THEN  deny_activate  reason=missing_act1154_status      # disabled-by-default: operational licensing expected by 2027
ELSE  treat_as=accountable_institution  apply=GH-REG-04, GH-REG-05, GH-REG-06
GH-GOV-11.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: GS12, GS13, GS15

GH-GOV-12.name: Internal service levels
GH-GOV-12.description: Triage a high-risk alert within 4 hours and reach an STR decision within 12 hours, inside the 24-hour statutory clock.
GH-GOV-12.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-12 | type=sla
WHEN  alert.created
IF    alert.risk = high AND NOW - alert.created > 4h AND alert.triaged = false   THEN escalate
IF    alert.suspicion_recorded AND NOW - alert.suspicion_start_ts > 12h AND alert.str_decision IS NULL   THEN escalate
GH-GOV-12.basis: [My design]. Param of Nigeria recommended SLAs. Default: On. Basis: My design

GH-GOV-13.name: Penalty exposure register
GH-GOV-13.description: Each regulatory rule shows its penalty in penalty units and a cedi estimate, so the board sees the cost of a missed duty. One penalty unit is GHS 12 per a GRA page; the effective date is unverified.
GH-GOV-13.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-GOV-13 | type=display
THEN  show(rule.penalty_units, rule.penalty_units * tenant.cfg.gh_penalty_unit_value)    # default GHS 12 (inference: GRA page citing Act 572)
GH-GOV-13.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS3, GS5, GS6, GS24

GH-REG-01.name: Wallet daily limit by KYC tier
GH-REG-01.description: A mobile-money wallet moves more in a day than its KYC tier allows: Minimum GHS 3,000, Medium GHS 15,000, Enhanced GHS 25,000 (limits effective 1 March 2024).
GH-REG-01.action: Hard: decline the transaction that would breach the limit
GH-REG-01.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-01 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  txn.type IN (wallet.send, wallet.cash_out, wallet.pay)
SCOPE tenant.type IN (emi, bank, psp) AND account.type = mobile_money_wallet
WINDOW 1d (calendar day, Africa/Accra) BY wallet.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount) + txn.amount > tenant.cfg.gh_tier_daily[wallet.kyc_tier]
      # default Minimum GHS 3_000 | Medium GHS 15_000 | Enhanced GHS 25_000 (BoG via Telecoms Chamber, 1 Mar 2024)
      # assumption: debits only count; direction scope to be confirmed with the operator guideline
THEN  decision=decline  reason=wallet_daily_limit
GH-REG-01.basis: [Regulatory]. New local (Nigeria keeps tier limits as per-institution config). Default: On. Basis: GS8, GS10 (conflict note)

GH-REG-02.name: Wallet maximum balance by KYC tier
GH-REG-02.description: A credit would push a wallet above the maximum balance for its tier: Minimum GHS 5,000, Medium GHS 40,000, Enhanced GHS 75,000.
GH-REG-02.action: Hard: reject or hold the excess credit
GH-REG-02.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-02 | control=hard | action=decline_credit
WHEN  txn.type = wallet.credit
SCOPE tenant.type IN (emi, bank, psp) AND account.type = mobile_money_wallet
IF    wallet.balance + txn.amount > tenant.cfg.gh_tier_balance[wallet.kyc_tier]
      # default Minimum GHS 5_000 | Medium GHS 40_000 | Enhanced GHS 75_000
THEN  decision=decline_credit  reason=wallet_balance_cap  notify=sender_operator
GH-REG-02.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS8

GH-REG-03.name: Wallet monthly limit by KYC tier
GH-REG-03.description: A Minimum-tier wallet moves more than GHS 10,000 in a month. Medium and Enhanced monthly caps could not be confirmed, so they are blank until the tenant enters them.
GH-REG-03.action: Hard for Minimum tier; Medium and Enhanced skipped until configured
GH-REG-03.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-03 | control=hard | action=decline
WHEN  txn.type IN (wallet.send, wallet.cash_out, wallet.pay)
SCOPE tenant.type IN (emi, bank, psp) AND account.type = mobile_money_wallet
WINDOW 30d (calendar month, Africa/Accra) BY wallet.id
IF    tenant.cfg.gh_tier_monthly[wallet.kyc_tier] IS NOT NULL
AND   SUM(txn.amount) + txn.amount > tenant.cfg.gh_tier_monthly[wallet.kyc_tier]
      # default Minimum GHS 10_000 | Medium NULL | Enhanced NULL   # threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default for Medium and Enhanced
THEN  decision=decline  reason=wallet_monthly_limit
GH-REG-03.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS8; notes conflict (see section 7)

GH-REG-04.name: Cash transaction report (CTR)
GH-REG-04.description: A cash deposit, withdrawal or payment reaches GHS 50,000 at a bank or securities firm, or GHS 20,000 at a specialised deposit-taking institution or forex bureau.
GH-REG-04.action: Report: prepare a CTR for the FIC; due within 24 hours of the transaction (configurable)
GH-REG-04.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-04 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  txn.type IN (cash.deposit, cash.withdrawal, cash.payment)
SCOPE txn.domestic = true
IF    txn.amount >= tenant.cfg.gh_ctr[tenant.type]
      # default bank, securities: GHS 50_000 | sdi, forex_bureau: GHS 20_000
      # >= used for safety; strict-or-equal wording not confirmed. Cash-only scope is an inference
THEN  task=report.CTR  due=tenant.cfg.gh_ctr_due          # default 24h after txn; FIC page says "filed daily"
      to=FIC  channel=tenant.cfg.fic_channel  gov=GH-GOV-03
GH-REG-04.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-17 (different amounts and scope). Default: On. Basis: GS1, GS2, GS3, GS9; vendor conflict GS11

GH-REG-05.name: Electronic transfer report (cross-border)
GH-REG-05.description: A cross-border transfer, in or out, of US$1,000 or more (or the cedi equivalent). Not US$10,000.
GH-REG-05.action: Report: prepare an electronic currency transaction report for the FIC within 24 hours of the transfer
GH-REG-05.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-05 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.international.in, transfer.international.out)
SCOPE tenant.type IN (bank, sdi, emi) AND tenant.cfg.ectr_reporter = true   # FIC page names commercial banks as reporters
IF    txn.amount_usd_equiv >= tenant.cfg.gh_ectr                            # default USD 1_000
THEN  task=report.ECTR  due=24h_after_txn  to=FIC  gov=GH-GOV-03
GH-REG-05.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-10 (threshold USD 1,000 instead of USD 10,000). Default: On. Basis: GS1, GS2 (s.2.9.2), GS3 (ss.40-42)

GH-REG-06.name: Suspicious transaction report (STR)
GH-REG-06.description: A staff member or the system forms a suspicion. The STR is due within 24 hours, with no minimum amount. Telling the customer is a crime.
GH-REG-06.action: Report: 24-hour filing clock to the FIC; block every customer-facing signal of the report
GH-REG-06.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-06 | control=hard | action=report
WHEN  alert.suspicion_recorded OR alert.suspicion_confirmed
IF    alert.suspicion_start_ts IS NOT NULL          # clock starts at the earliest recorded suspicion (s.38 wording), not at analyst sign-off (BoG wording)
THEN  task=report.STR  due=tenant.cfg.gh_str_due   # default 24h from suspicion_start_ts; no minimum amount
      to=FIC  gov=GH-GOV-02, GH-GOV-03
GH-REG-06.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-14 (24h clock; no 72h screening stage found in Ghana sources). Default: On. Basis: GS2 (s.2.8.2), GS3 (s.38)

GH-REG-07.name: Politically exposed person (PEP)
GH-REG-07.description: The customer or an owner behind a company is a PEP. Senior management must approve the relationship; source of wealth is verified; PEP transactions are reported to the FIC.
GH-REG-07.action: Hard: enhanced due diligence and senior approval; add transactions to the PEP report
GH-REG-07.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-07 | control=hard | action=edd
WHEN  customer.onboarded OR customer.periodic_review OR txn.created
IF    customer.is_pep = true OR ANY(beneficial_owner.is_pep = true)
THEN  decision=review  require=edd,source_of_funds,source_of_wealth,senior_approval  reason=pep
      add_to=pep_transaction_report  to=FIC  review_cycle=tenant.cfg.gh_pep_review      # default 2y
GH-REG-07.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-12 and REG-18. Default: On. Basis: GS2 (s.2.7.1, s.2.4.5), GS4 (s.49(2)(a)(ii))

GH-REG-08.name: Sanctions and UN freeze
GH-REG-08.description: A name, ID or account matches the UN Security Council lists, Ghana designations or other configured lists. Freeze without prior notice and tell the FIC.
GH-REG-08.action: Hard: block, freeze, open case, report; freeze service level is a placeholder
GH-REG-08.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-08 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  txn.created OR customer.onboarded OR list.updated
IF    screen(party.name, party.id, party.account) MATCHES lists(un_consolidated, gh_designations, tenant_lists)
        USING fuzzy + transliteration  score >= tenant.cfg.match_threshold
AND   match.reviewed = confirmed OR tenant.cfg.auto_block_on_strong_match = true
THEN  decision=block  freeze=account  case=open  task=report.FIC  reason=sanctions_match
      freeze_sla=tenant.cfg.gh_freeze_sla     # PLACEHOLDER 24h [My design]; E.I. 2 says freeze without prior notice, no hour count retrieved
      gov=GH-GOV-02
GH-REG-08.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of REG-11 (freeze clock placeholder). Default: On. Basis: GS7 (E.I. 2), GS3 (s.56)

GH-REG-09.name: Ghana Card identity at onboarding
GH-REG-09.description: A customer is opened without a verified Ghana Card. Mandatory for forex bureaux; other tenants switch it on if their licence guideline requires it.
GH-REG-09.action: Hard for forex bureaux; tenant toggle for others: block the account action
GH-REG-09.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-09 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  account.open OR customer.onboarded OR kyc.refresh
SCOPE tenant.type = forex_bureau OR tenant.cfg.require_ghana_card = true
IF    identity.ghana_card_verified != true            # NIA verification result stored by the identity provider interface
THEN  decision=block  reason=ghana_card_not_verified  require=collect_ghana_card
GH-REG-09.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of REG-06 and REG-16 (Ghana Card instead of BVN or NIN). Default: On. Basis: GS9; GS24 (s.35, ID types)

GH-REG-10.name: No anonymous or fictitious accounts
GH-REG-10.description: An account is opened or kept without a verified, real identity behind it.
GH-REG-10.action: Hard: block opening; restrict and review existing accounts
GH-REG-10.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-10 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  account.open OR kyc.refresh OR daily_job
IF    ANY OF ( kyc.identity_verified = false , customer.name IS NULL , account.nominal_holder = true AND beneficial_owner IS NULL )
THEN  decision=block  restrict=account  case=open  reason=anonymous_or_fictitious_account
GH-REG-10.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS4 (s.48(1)(a)); GS3

GH-REG-11.name: FIC suspension and freeze orders
GH-REG-11.description: The FIC suspends a transaction (up to 7 working days) or freezes an account. The institution applies the hold, lets it expire on the right date and does not tip off the customer.
GH-REG-11.action: Hard: hold with automatic expiry and audit entry
GH-REG-11.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-11 | control=hard | action=hold
WHEN  order.received
SCOPE order.source = FIC AND order.type IN (suspension, freeze)
THEN  hold=transaction_or_account  hold_max=7_working_days  expire=auto  audit=log
      visibility=compliance_only  gov=GH-GOV-02
      # s.45 suspension up to 7 working days; s.56 freeze, court application within 7 working days (E.I. 2 summary says 48h: unresolved)
GH-REG-11.basis: [Regulatory]. Analogue of the 72h NFIU stop order (Nigeria section 8). Default: On. Basis: GS3 (ss.45, 56, per summary)

GH-REG-12.name: Forex bureau high-value checks
GH-REG-12.description: A forex bureau customer buys or sells US$10,000 or more. Enhanced due diligence and biometric verification are required. Cash above GHS 20,000 also triggers the CTR in GH-REG-04.
GH-REG-12.action: Hard (forex bureaux only): require EDD and biometrics
GH-REG-12.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-12 | control=hard | action=edd
WHEN  txn.type IN (forex.buy, forex.sell)
SCOPE tenant.type = forex_bureau
IF    txn.amount_usd_equiv >= tenant.cfg.gh_forex_edd        # default USD 10_000
THEN  decision=review  require=edd,biometric_verification,ghana_card  reason=forex_high_value
GH-REG-12.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS9

GH-REG-13.name: Virtual-asset Travel Rule data
GH-REG-13.description: A virtual-asset transfer above the Travel Rule limit lacks sender or receiver details. The Ghana limit and data fields are not yet published, so the rule ships off.
GH-REG-13.action: Hard when enabled: hold crediting or release
GH-REG-13.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-REG-13 | control=hard | action=hold
WHEN  crypto.transfer
SCOPE tenant.type = vasp AND tenant.cfg.gh_travel_rule_enabled = true
IF    txn.amount_usd_equiv >= tenant.cfg.gh_travel_rule_min      # PLACEHOLDER NULL: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
AND   ANY OF ( originator.data_complete = false , beneficiary.data_complete = false )
THEN  decision=hold  reason=travel_rule_data_missing  link=CRY-13
GH-REG-13.basis: [Industry practice]. Cross-reference CRY-13 (threshold not found). Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: GS12, GS13, GS14, GS17 (secondary)

GH-SEC-01.name: Stolen-password testing (credential stuffing)
GH-SEC-01.description: Ten or more failed logins from one network address across five or more accounts in 5 minutes.
GH-SEC-01.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-01 | weight=30
WHEN  auth.failure
WINDOW 5m BY ip
IF    COUNT(auth.failure) >= 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT account.id) >= 5
THEN  signal=GH-SEC-01  action_hint=rate_limit_ip
GH-SEC-01.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-01. Default: On. Basis: GS23

GH-SEC-02.name: Approval-prompt flooding and OTP interception
GH-SEC-02.description: Five or more push or OTP prompts to one user in 10 minutes, or an OTP used from a different device than the one that requested it.
GH-SEC-02.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-02 | weight=25
WHEN  mfa.prompt_sent OR otp.used
WINDOW 10m BY account.id
IF    COUNT(mfa.prompt_sent WHERE type IN (push, otp)) >= 5
   OR EXISTS(otp.used WHERE otp.requesting_device != otp.using_device)
THEN  signal=GH-SEC-02  action_hint=pause_prompts
GH-SEC-02.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-04 (OTP interception clause added). Default: On. Basis: GS35 (OTP interception)

GH-SEC-03.name: API key misuse
GH-SEC-03.description: A key is used from a new network or country, at five times its normal rate, or with many failed or not-found requests.
GH-SEC-03.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-03 | weight=30
WHEN  api.request
SCOPE auth.type = api_key
IF    ANY OF ( request.network NOT IN key.known_networks , request.country NOT IN key.known_countries ,
               RATE(request OVER 5m) > 5 * key.baseline_rate ,
               RATIO(status IN (400, 404) OVER 10m) > tenant.cfg.probe_ratio )
THEN  signal=GH-SEC-03  action_hint=throttle_key
GH-SEC-03.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-08. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library SEC-08

GH-SEC-04.name: Rights raised, then data exported
GH-SEC-04.description: A user's role is upgraded and they export data within the hour.
GH-SEC-04.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-04 | weight=30
WHEN  data.export
WINDOW 1h BY user.id
IF    EXISTS(user.role_changed)
THEN  signal=GH-SEC-04
GH-SEC-04.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-10. Default: On. Basis: GS26 (breach duty)

GH-SEC-05.name: Unusually large export
GH-SEC-05.description: An export far above the user's or institution's normal size. A large unexplained export may be a reportable personal-data breach.
GH-SEC-05.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-05 | weight=25
WHEN  data.export
IF    export.rows > 5 * BASELINE(export.rows BY user.id OVER 30d)
   OR export.rows > 5 * BASELINE(export.rows BY tenant.id OVER 30d)
THEN  signal=GH-SEC-05  link=GH-SEC-12
GH-SEC-05.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-12. Default: On. Basis: GS26

GH-SEC-06.name: Payee or payout details changed, then a large payment
GH-SEC-06.description: A supplier bank account, webhook address or payout destination is changed, then a high-value payment follows within 24 hours. Business-email fraud had 0% recovery in the GAB sample.
GH-SEC-06.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-06 | weight=30 | action=review
WHEN  txn.created
WINDOW 24h BY customer.id OR merchant.id
IF    EXISTS(config.changed WHERE field IN (webhook_url, payout_destination, bank_account, supplier_account))
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.high_value             # suggested GHS 5_000 retail; GHS 50_000 for bank e-transfer tier
THEN  signal=GH-SEC-06  action_hint=hold_payout
GH-SEC-06.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of SEC-09. Default: On. Basis: GS29

GH-SEC-07.name: Staff access, then customer takeover
GH-SEC-07.description: Staff viewed or changed a customer's contact details or limits, then money leaves that customer's account within 24 hours.
GH-SEC-07.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-07 | weight=30 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 24h BY customer.id
IF    EXISTS(staff_action WHERE type IN (view_contact, change_contact, change_limits))
THEN  signal=GH-SEC-07  evidence=(staff.id, action, time)  visibility=compliance_only
GH-SEC-07.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of INS-02. Default: On. Basis: GS28, GS29 (insiders)

GH-SEC-08.name: CSA incident and vulnerability clocks
GH-SEC-08.description: If the institution is a designated critical information infrastructure owner, report significant incidents to the Cyber Security Authority within 24 hours of detection and disclose vulnerabilities within 72 hours.
GH-SEC-08.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-08 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  incident.detected
SCOPE tenant.cii_designated = true
IF    incident.severity IN tenant.cfg.csa_significant_levels
THEN  task=notify.CSA  due=24h_from_detection  contact=24x7  gov=GH-GOV-09
WHEN  vulnerability.confirmed
SCOPE tenant.cii_designated = true
THEN  task=disclose.CSA  due=72h
      # whether the clocks cover all financial institutions or only designated CII is unconfirmed (primary text of Act 1038 not retrieved)
GH-SEC-08.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of Nigeria section 8 incident clocks. Default: On. Basis: GS18, GS19 (secondary)

GH-SEC-09.name: Report to Bank of Ghana within 10 days
GH-SEC-09.description: A payment institution must report suspected or confirmed fraud, a security breach, a material service interruption or loss of confidential data to the Bank of Ghana within 10 days. A faster clock may exist in the 2026 cyber directive but was not found.
GH-SEC-09.action: Legal clock: 10 days outer limit; faster placeholder
GH-SEC-09.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-09 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  incident.detected
SCOPE tenant.type IN (emi, psp, payment_institution)
IF    incident.type IN (fraud_suspected, fraud_confirmed, security_breach, material_service_interruption, confidential_data_loss)
THEN  task=report.BoG  due=MIN(10d, tenant.cfg.bog_cisd_clock)
      # tenant.cfg.bog_cisd_clock default NULL: BoG CISD 2026 hour clock not found; threshold to be confirmed
      # exposure: s.42(3) 500 penalty units plus 50 per day (about GHS 6,000 plus GHS 600 per day at GHS 12 per unit; inference)
GH-SEC-09.basis: [Regulatory]. New local (Nigeria clock is 24h to CBN). Default: On. Basis: GS24 (s.42(5), s.42(3)); GS25

GH-SEC-10.name: Outsourcing notice and SLA filing
GH-SEC-10.description: Before outsourcing a function, give the Bank of Ghana written notice; file the signed service agreement within 10 days of signing.
GH-SEC-10.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-10 | control=clock | action=task
WHEN  outsourcing.planned
SCOPE tenant.type IN (emi, psp, payment_institution)
THEN  task=notify.BoG  due=before_signing
WHEN  outsourcing.signed
THEN  task=submit.SLA_to_BoG  due=10d_after_signing
GH-SEC-10.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS24 (s.38)

GH-SEC-11.name: Audit log completeness and 6-year retention
GH-SEC-11.description: Every user action on the payment platform must be logged and kept for at least 6 years. A gap or an early deletion raises an alert.
GH-SEC-11.action: Hard: deny delete; alert on gaps
GH-SEC-11.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-11 | control=hard | action=deny
WHEN  audit_log.integrity_job OR record.delete_requested
IF    audit_log.coverage < 100%  THEN alert=log_gap
IF    record.type = audit_log AND record.age < 6y THEN deny_delete reason=act987_log_retention
GH-SEC-11.basis: [Regulatory]. Stricter than GOV-08 (6 years for logs). Default: On. Basis: GS24 (ss.20, 34)

GH-SEC-12.name: Personal-data breach notice to the DPC
GH-SEC-12.description: Reasonable grounds to believe personal data was accessed or acquired by an unauthorised person. Notify the Data Protection Commission and affected people as soon as reasonably practicable. The law has no hour count; 72 hours is a design default.
GH-SEC-12.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-12 | control=clock | action=report
WHEN  breach.confirmed
IF    breach.personal_data = true AND breach.unauthorised_access = true
THEN  task=notify.DPC  due=tenant.cfg.dpc_internal_clock       # default 72h [My design]; statute: as soon as reasonably practicable
      task=notify.data_subjects  content=(nature, measures, likely_consequences)
GH-SEC-12.basis: [Regulatory]. Param of Nigeria NDPA 72h clock (Ghana statute has no hour count). Default: On. Basis: GS26

GH-SEC-13.name: Personal data leaving Ghana
GH-SEC-13.description: Personal data is sent abroad without recorded consent and safeguards. A Bank of Ghana approval requirement under the 2026 directive was reported by a vendor and is unconfirmed, so that part ships off.
GH-SEC-13.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-13 | control=hard | action=flag
WHEN  data.transfer
SCOPE destination.country != GH AND data.class = personal
IF    NOT ( consent.recorded = true AND safeguards.recorded = true )
THEN  flag=cross_border_transfer  hold=transfer_job
IF    tenant.cfg.cisd_bog_transfer_approval = true AND transfer.bog_approval IS NULL     # default false: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
THEN  hold=transfer_job  reason=bog_approval_missing
GH-SEC-13.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: GS26 (Templars); GS25 (Group-IB, vendor)

GH-SEC-14.name: Cybersecurity vendor licence check
GH-SEC-14.description: A penetration tester or security provider is used without a valid Cyber Security Authority licence. Unlicensed provision is unlawful and the CSA has enforced licensing from 31 January 2026.
GH-SEC-14.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-SEC-14 | control=hard | action=block
WHEN  vendor.onboard OR vendor.annual_review
SCOPE vendor.service = cybersecurity
IF    vendor.csa_licence_status != valid
THEN  decision=block  reason=unlicensed_cybersecurity_provider
GH-SEC-14.basis: [Regulatory]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS20

GH-TM-01.name: New device, new payee, then large transfer
GH-TM-01.description: Within 30 minutes: a new device or app is linked, a new payee is added, and money is sent above the institution's minimum. Ghana has no found cap on new-device transfers like Nigeria's REG-01, so this only scores.
GH-TM-01.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-01 | weight=30 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 30m BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(device.bound WHERE device.is_new = true)
AND   EXISTS(beneficiary.added WHERE beneficiary.is_new = true)
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor                     # suggested default GHS 2_000 (average MoMo ticket about GHS 528, Dec 2025)
THEN  signal=GH-TM-01  evidence=(device.id, beneficiary.id, times)
GH-TM-01.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of ATO-01 (no Ghana equivalent of REG-01 found). Default: On. Basis: GS23, GS29 (modus operandi)

GH-TM-02.name: SIM swap, then transfer or cash-out
GH-TM-02.description: The telco reports a SIM swap, or the SIM or device was re-registered in the last 72 hours, then money is sent or cashed out.
GH-TM-02.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-02 | weight=25 | action=step_up
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send, wallet.cash_out)
IF    ANY OF ( telco.sim_swap_flag = true , EXISTS(sim.reregistered OVER tenant.cfg.sim_swap_window) , EXISTS(device.reregistered OVER tenant.cfg.sim_swap_window) )
      # default window 72h
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=GH-TM-02  evidence=(swap_source, swap_time)
GH-TM-02.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of ATO-03. Default: On. Basis: GS23, GS35

GH-TM-03.name: Credentials changed, then electronic transfer
GH-TM-03.description: Password, PIN, phone or email changed in the last 24 hours, then an electronic transfer above the minimum. E-transfers were half of all bank fraud cases in the GAB sample.
GH-TM-03.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-03 | weight=25 | action=step_up
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
IF    ANY OF ( EXISTS(profile.password_changed OVER 24h) , EXISTS(profile.pin_changed OVER 24h) ,
               EXISTS(profile.phone_changed OVER 24h) , EXISTS(profile.email_changed OVER 24h) )
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=GH-TM-03  evidence=(change_type, change_time)
GH-TM-03.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of ATO-02. Default: On. Basis: GS29

GH-TM-04.name: Impossible travel or new country
GH-TM-04.description: A login or payment from a country the customer does not normally use (10 points), or two events too far apart to travel between in the time (20 points).
GH-TM-04.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-04 | weight=10 or 20
WHEN  session.login OR txn.created
IF    geo.country NOT IN profile.usual_countries THEN signal=GH-TM-04 weight=10
IF    distance(geo, previous.geo) / time_between > 900 km/h THEN signal=GH-TM-04 weight=20   # impossible travel
GH-TM-04.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of BEH-02. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library BEH-02

GH-TM-05.name: Sudden spike against the customer's own pattern
GH-TM-05.description: Money sent in 24 hours is more than three times the customer's usual daily amount and above the institution's minimum.
GH-TM-05.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-05 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount) > 3 * AVG(daily_outbound OVER 30d)
AND   SUM(txn.amount) > tenant.cfg.floor                 # suggested GHS 5_000 for retail wallets; tune per segment
THEN  signal=GH-TM-05  evidence=(sum_24h, avg_30d)
GH-TM-05.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of VEL-02. Default: On. Basis: GS34 (average ticket)

GH-TM-06.name: Burst of transfers
GH-TM-06.description: Five or more transfers out in 10 minutes.
GH-TM-06.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-06 | weight=15
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 10m BY account.id
IF    COUNT(txn) >= 5
THEN  signal=GH-TM-06  evidence=(count, window)
GH-TM-06.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of VEL-01. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library VEL-01

GH-TM-07.name: Splitting to stay under wallet-tier limits
GH-TM-07.description: Three or more transactions in 24 hours each just under the wallet's daily limit, or the wallet uses 80% or more of its daily limit on three days in a week.
GH-TM-07.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-07 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (wallet.send, wallet.cash_out)
SCOPE account.type = mobile_money_wallet
IF    ANY OF ( COUNT(txn WHERE txn.amount BETWEEN 0.90*L AND 0.999*L OVER 24h BY wallet.id) >= 3 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT day WHERE SUM(txn.amount)/L >= 0.80 OVER 7d BY wallet.id) >= 3 )
      WHERE L = tenant.cfg.gh_tier_daily[wallet.kyc_tier]
THEN  signal=GH-TM-07  evidence=(limit, amounts)
GH-TM-07.basis: [My design]. New local (tier-limit variant of VEL-04). Default: On. Basis: GS8; inference only

GH-TM-08.name: Splitting cash to stay under the CTR line
GH-TM-08.description: Three or more cash deposits or withdrawals within 5 days, each between 90% and 99.9% of the CTR amount, including across branches or linked accounts.
GH-TM-08.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-08 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (cash.deposit, cash.withdrawal)
WINDOW 5d BY customer.id INCLUDING linked_accounts, branches
IF    COUNT(txn WHERE txn.amount BETWEEN 0.90*T AND 0.999*T) >= 3
      WHERE T = tenant.cfg.gh_ctr[tenant.type]            # GHS 50_000 or GHS 20_000; FIC publishes no separate band
THEN  signal=GH-TM-08  evidence=(threshold, amounts, branches)
GH-TM-08.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of VEL-04 (5-day window, multi-branch aggregation). Default: On. Basis: GS30 (FIC typology), GS1

GH-TM-09.name: Many senders into one wallet
GH-TM-09.description: Ten or more different senders pay one wallet or account in 24 hours (prize, romance or investment collections).
GH-TM-09.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-09 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.inbound
WINDOW 24h BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id) >= 10
THEN  signal=GH-TM-09
GH-TM-09.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-02. Default: On. Basis: GS28, GS35

GH-TM-10.name: Money passing straight through
GH-TM-10.description: 80% or more of money received leaves within 60 minutes.
GH-TM-10.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-10 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 60m BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=out) >= 0.80 * SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in)
AND   SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in) > tenant.cfg.floor
THEN  signal=GH-TM-10  evidence=(in_sum, out_sum, ratio)
GH-TM-10.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-01. Default: On. Basis: GS28, GS34

GH-TM-11.name: One payment split many ways
GH-TM-11.description: One incoming payment is split among five or more recipients within 60 minutes.
GH-TM-11.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-11 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 60m BY source_inflow.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary.id) >= 5
THEN  signal=GH-TM-11
GH-TM-11.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-03. Default: On. Basis: GS28

GH-TM-12.name: Quick cash-out after money arrives
GH-TM-12.description: Money arrives by card or peer-to-peer and 70% or more is withdrawn at an ATM, POS or agent within 30 minutes.
GH-TM-12.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-12 | weight=15
WHEN  txn.type IN (atm.withdrawal, pos.purchase, wallet.cash_out)
WINDOW 30m BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(inflow WHERE source IN (card, p2p, wallet))
AND   txn.amount >= 0.70 * inflow.amount
THEN  signal=GH-TM-12
GH-TM-12.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-08 (agent cash-out added). Default: On. Basis: GS28

GH-TM-13.name: New account, big volume
GH-TM-13.description: A wallet or account under 7 days old moves more than ten times what is normal for its KYC tier.
GH-TM-13.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-13 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.created
SCOPE account.age < 7d
IF    SUM(txn.amount OVER account.age) > 10 * kyc_tier.norm(account.kyc_tier)
THEN  signal=GH-TM-13  evidence=(volume, tier_norm)
GH-TM-13.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-04. Default: On. Basis: GS28

GH-TM-14.name: Dormant account wakes up
GH-TM-14.description: No activity for 90 days or more, then a large payment in or out.
GH-TM-14.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-14 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.created
IF    account.days_since_last_activity >= 90
AND   txn.amount > tenant.cfg.large_after_dormancy        # suggested GHS 5_000
THEN  signal=GH-TM-14
GH-TM-14.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-05. Default: On. Basis: Nigeria library MUL-05

GH-TM-15.name: Shared Ghana Card, phone or device across wallets
GH-TM-15.description: One device is used on three or more accounts, or one Ghana Card number, phone number or address appears on several accounts or applications.
GH-TM-15.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-15 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  account.created OR application.submitted OR txn.created
IF    ANY OF ( COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY device.id) >= 3 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY ghana_card_no) >= 2 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY phone) >= 2 ,
               COUNT(DISTINCT account.id BY address) >= 2 )
THEN  signal=GH-TM-15  evidence=(shared_identifier, linked_accounts)
GH-TM-15.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of MUL-06 (Ghana Card number added). Default: On. Basis: GS28, GS29

GH-TM-16.name: Agent float anomaly
GH-TM-16.description: An agent's float top-ups or cash-in and cash-out cycling run far above similar agents, or many of the agent's customers are brand-new wallets. No Ghana float data was found, so every number is a placeholder.
GH-TM-16.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-16 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  agent.daily_job
SCOPE agent.active = true
IF    ANY OF ( agent.float_topup_24h > tenant.cfg.float_peer_mult * peer_group.p95(float_topup_24h) ,
               (agent.cash_in_24h + agent.cash_out_24h) / agent.float_balance > tenant.cfg.float_cycle_max ,
               agent.share_new_wallets_7d > tenant.cfg.new_wallet_share_max )
      # PLACEHOLDER values: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default; calibrate on operator data
THEN  signal=GH-TM-16  evidence=(agent.id, float_metrics)  visibility=compliance_only
GH-TM-16.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: Nigeria library gap; GS34 (491,000 agents); no float source

GH-TM-17.name: Insider cash suppression
GH-TM-17.description: A teller, relationship officer or sales agent records cash received but the deposit is not posted, end-of-day cash differs from the ledger, or staff debit dormant customer accounts. BoG reported GH¢40.7m cash-suppression risk in 2025.
GH-TM-17.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-17 | weight=30 | action=review
WHEN  eod.reconciliation OR staff.txn
SCOPE staff.role IN (teller, relationship_officer, direct_sales_agent)
IF    ANY OF ( ABS(cash_received_recorded - cash_posted_to_ledger) > tenant.cfg.variance_tolerance ,   # default GHS 0
               COUNT(staff.initiated_debit WHERE account.dormant = true OVER 30d) >= 1 ,
               staff.manual_override_count OVER 30d > peer_group.p95(manual_override_count) )
THEN  signal=GH-TM-17  visibility=compliance_only  evidence=(staff.id, variance)   # gov=GH-GOV-02
GH-TM-17.basis: [Industry practice]. New local (extends INS-01). Default: On. Basis: GS28, GS29

GH-TM-18.name: Personal account used as a business account
GH-TM-18.description: A personal account shows business-like turnover: repeated transfers with business accounts, funds from a shareholder labelled as loans or borrowing, or heavy activity in relatives' accounts. These are FIC tax-evasion red flags.
GH-TM-18.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-18 | weight=20
WHEN  daily_job
SCOPE account.type = personal
WINDOW 30d BY account.id
IF    SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in) > 5 * peer_group.p95(SUM OVER 30d)
AND   ANY OF ( COUNT(txn WHERE counterparty.type = business) >= tenant.cfg.pb_transfers_min ,   # default 5
               COUNT(txn WHERE memo MATCHES (loan, borrow) AND counterparty.is_shareholder = true) >= 1 ,
               linked_relatives_accounts.volume > tenant.cfg.relative_volume_floor )
THEN  signal=GH-TM-18  evidence=(turnover, counterparties)
GH-TM-18.basis: [Industry practice]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS30

GH-TM-19.name: Gold-trade pattern (galamsey)
GH-TM-19.description: A personal or small-business account receives money from gold buyers, aggregators or forex bureaux and cashes out quickly. The FIC has published no galamsey red-flag list, so this needs a counterparty tag list and tenant values.
GH-TM-19.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-19 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.inbound OR cash.withdrawal
WINDOW 7d BY account.id
SCOPE account.type IN (personal, sme)
IF    SUM(txn.amount WHERE counterparty.tag IN (gold_buyer, gold_aggregator, forex_bureau)) >= tenant.cfg.gold_inflow_floor
      # PLACEHOLDER NULL: threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
AND   SUM(cash_out OVER 48h after inflow) >= 0.70 * inflow
THEN  signal=GH-TM-19  evidence=(counterparties, amounts)
GH-TM-19.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: GS31 (Swissaid, gold share of exports); no FIC list

GH-TM-20.name: Payment to an unlicensed digital lender
GH-TM-20.description: A payment goes to, or a borrower receives money from, a lender on the BoG list of unlicensed digital credit providers (20 named on 3 August 2026).
GH-TM-20.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-20 | weight=30 | action=review
WHEN  txn.created
IF    counterparty.name_or_id IN list.bog_unlicensed_digital_lenders
OR    counterparty.tag = unlicensed_lender
THEN  signal=GH-TM-20  evidence=(counterparty, list_version)
GH-TM-20.basis: [My design]. New local (list-based). Default: On. Basis: GS32

GH-TM-21.name: Borrow and cash out
GH-TM-21.description: 90% or more of a loan is moved out within 30 minutes of payout, or the borrower sends it to several numbers.
GH-TM-21.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-21 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 30m BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(loan.disbursement)
AND   SUM(txn.amount) >= 0.90 * loan.disbursement.amount
THEN  signal=GH-TM-21
GH-TM-21.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of LEN-02. Default: On. Basis: GS32

GH-TM-22.name: Ponzi-style pooling
GH-TM-22.description: Twenty or more unrelated senders pay one account in 7 days, and 30% or more of what it pays out goes to people who paid in earlier. Memos promising fixed or doubled returns add support.
GH-TM-22.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-22 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.inbound
WINDOW 7d BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id WHERE unrelated = true) >= 20
AND   SUM(outflow WHERE recipient IN prior_senders) >= 0.30 * SUM(outflow)
THEN  signal=GH-TM-22  evidence=(senders, recycled_share, memo_flags)
GH-TM-22.basis: [Industry practice]. Param of PON-01. Default: On. Basis: GS33

GH-TM-23.name: Wrong-transfer scam
GH-TM-23.description: An unexpected credit from a first-time sender is followed within hours by a 'please send it back' payment to a different number. No Ghana loss figures were found, so this ships off.
GH-TM-23.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-23 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 2h BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(inflow WHERE sender.is_first_time = true AND inflow.amount >= tenant.cfg.wrong_transfer_min)   # PLACEHOLDER, disabled-by-default
AND   txn.beneficiary != inflow.sender
AND   txn.amount >= 0.80 * inflow.amount
THEN  signal=GH-TM-23
GH-TM-23.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: GS28, GS35 (social engineering); inference only

GH-TM-24.name: Cross-network pass-through (interoperability)
GH-TM-24.description: A freshly funded wallet sends most of its money to another network through GhIPSS interoperability within an hour. Interoperable flows are small, so this is a layering hint, not a sourced typology.
GH-TM-24.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-24 | weight=20
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.interoperable.out
WINDOW 60m BY wallet.id
IF    wallet.age < 7d
AND   SUM(txn.amount WHERE interoperable = true) >= 0.80 * SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in)
AND   SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in) > tenant.cfg.floor
      # threshold to be confirmed; disabled-by-default
THEN  signal=GH-TM-24
GH-TM-24.basis: [My design]. New local. Default: Off (threshold to be confirmed). Basis: GS34; inference only

GH-TM-25.name: Romance-scam proceeds passed on
GH-TM-25.description: A foreign transfer arrives and 70% or more is sent on to three or more Ghanaian accounts within 72 hours. Where the sender profile is known, an elderly overseas sender strengthens the signal.
GH-TM-25.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-25 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type = transfer.outbound
WINDOW 72h BY account.id
IF    EXISTS(inflow WHERE inflow.type = transfer.international.in AND inflow.amount_usd_equiv >= tenant.cfg.gh_ectr)
AND   COUNT(DISTINCT beneficiary.id) >= 3
AND   SUM(txn.amount) >= 0.70 * inflow.amount
THEN  signal=GH-TM-25  evidence=(inflow.sender, beneficiaries)   # optional boost +5 if sender.age >= 65
GH-TM-25.basis: [Industry practice]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS36 (EOCO, US DOJ)

GH-TM-26.name: Splitting forex deals under the US$10,000 line
GH-TM-26.description: A forex bureau customer makes two or more deals within 7 days, each between 90% and 99.9% of US$10,000.
GH-TM-26.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-26 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (forex.buy, forex.sell)
SCOPE tenant.type = forex_bureau
WINDOW 7d BY customer.id
IF    COUNT(txn WHERE txn.amount_usd_equiv BETWEEN 0.90*tenant.cfg.gh_forex_edd AND 0.999*tenant.cfg.gh_forex_edd) >= 2
THEN  signal=GH-TM-26
GH-TM-26.basis: [My design]. New local (derived from the forex EDD trigger). Default: On. Basis: GS9; derivation is my design

GH-TM-27.name: Exposure to FATF-listed jurisdictions
GH-TM-27.description: A cross-border transfer involves a country on the FATF increased-monitoring list. The FIC asks for risk-based heightened scrutiny, not blanket enhanced due diligence.
GH-TM-27.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-27 | weight=10
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.international.in, transfer.international.out)
IF    counterparty.country IN tenant.cfg.fatf_increased_monitoring_list     # list maintained by tenant; 23 jurisdictions at the time of the advisory
THEN  signal=GH-TM-27  require=risk_based_scrutiny   # not blanket EDD
GH-TM-27.basis: [Industry practice]. New local. Default: On. Basis: GS38 (FIC advisory, 25 Aug 2025)

GH-TM-28.name: Mobile money to crypto off-ramp
GH-TM-28.description: Many senders fund one wallet and 70% or more of it goes to crypto exchanges or peer-to-peer crypto counterparties within 7 days. Cross-reference CRY-01 and CRY-08.
GH-TM-28.engineering_logic:
RULE GH-TM-28 | weight=25 | action=review
WHEN  txn.type IN (transfer.outbound, wallet.send)
WINDOW 7d BY account.id
IF    COUNT(DISTINCT sender.id) >= 10
AND   SUM(txn.amount WHERE counterparty.tag IN (vasp, p2p_crypto, crypto_linked)) >= 0.70 * SUM(txn.amount WHERE direction=in)
THEN  signal=GH-TM-28  link=CRY-01,CRY-08
GH-TM-28.basis: [My design]. New local (cross-reference CRY-01, CRY-08). Default: On. Basis: GS12, GS15 (Act 1154 not yet operational)
